    # Normalize the starting path
    if path.startswith('/'):
        current = ''
    else:
        current = cwd
    
    # Split path into components
    components = path.split('/')
    
    # Track number of links followed
    link_count = 0
    max_links = 8
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(components):
        component = components[i]
        i += 1
        
        # Skip empty components and '.'
        if component == '' or component == '.':
            continue
        
        # Handle '..'
        if component == '..':
            # Move to parent directory
            if current == '':
                # Already at root
                current = ''
            else:
                # Remove last component
                parts = current.rsplit('/', 1)
                current = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
            continue
        
        # Append the component to current path
        if current == '':
            current = '/' + component
        else:
            current = current + '/' + component
        
        # Check if this path is a symlink
        while current in links:
            link_count += 1
            if link_count > max_links:
                return None
            
            # Get the symlink target
            target = links[current]
            
            # Process remaining components + target components
            target_components = target.split('/')
            
            # If target is absolute, start from root
            if target.startswith('/'):
                current = ''
                to_process = target_components + components[i:]
            else:
                # Target is relative to the directory containing the link
                # current is the link, we need its parent directory
                if current == '':
                    parent = ''
                else:
                    parts = current.rsplit('/', 1)
                    parent = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
                
                current = parent
                to_process = target_components + components[i:]
            
            # Reset components and index to continue resolving
            components = to_process
            i = 0
    
    # Return the result
    if current == '':
        return '/'
    else:
        return current
